tools.name: archive_course_export_bundle
tools.description: Runs the course packaging script for a given course to build an export bundle, then moves the finished bundle into the archive folder for that term.

params.name: course_id
params.description: Identifier of the course to package

params.name: term_code
params.description: Term code used to choose the archive folder, such as 2026FA

tools.code:
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from langchain_core.tools import tool

EXPORT_STAGING_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/lms/export_staging")
ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/var/lms/archives")
PACKAGING_SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/lms/scripts/package_course.py"


@tool
def archive_course_export_bundle(course_id: str, term_code: str) -> str:
    staging_bundle_file_path = EXPORT_STAGING_DIRECTORY / f"{course_id}.zip"
    packaging_command_arguments = [
        "python3",
        PACKAGING_SCRIPT_PATH,
        "--course",
        course_id,
        "--output",
        str(staging_bundle_file_path),
    ]
    completed_packaging_process = subprocess.run(
        packaging_command_arguments,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
    )
    if completed_packaging_process.returncode != 0:
        return f"Packaging failed: {completed_packaging_process.stderr.strip()}"
    destination_term_directory = ARCHIVE_ROOT_DIRECTORY / term_code
    destination_term_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    final_archived_bundle_path = destination_term_directory / staging_bundle_file_path.name
    shutil.move(str(staging_bundle_file_path), str(final_archived_bundle_path))
    return f"Bundle archived at {final_archived_bundle_path}"

tools.name: apply_late_penalty_to_submissions
tools.description: Looks up the submissions for an assignment that were turned in after the due date and lowers their scores by a percentage penalty. Returns the number of submissions that were updated.

params.name: penalty_percent
params.description: Percentage of the score to deduct from each late submission

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DATABASE_PATH = "lms.db"


def _penalized_score(original_score, penalty_percent):
    reduced = original_score * (1 - penalty_percent / 100.0)
    return round(max(reduced, 0.0), 2)


def apply_late_penalty_to_submissions(assignment_id: int, penalty_percent: float) -> str:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        cursor = connection.cursor()
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT due_at FROM assignments WHERE id = ?", (assignment_id,)
        )
        assignment_row = cursor.fetchone()
        if assignment_row is None:
            return "Assignment not found"
        due_at = assignment_row[0]
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT id, score FROM submissions "
            "WHERE assignment_id = ? AND submitted_at > ? AND score IS NOT NULL",
            (assignment_id, due_at),
        )
        late_rows = cursor.fetchall()
        for submission_id, score in late_rows:
            cursor.execute(
                "UPDATE submissions SET score = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (_penalized_score(score, penalty_percent), submission_id),
            )
        connection.commit()
        return f"Updated {len(late_rows)} late submissions"
    finally:
        connection.close()

tools.name: transfer_course_ownership
tools.description: Makes a different instructor the owner of a course, moving the course record out of the previous instructor's course list and into the new instructor's list.

params.name: course_id
params.description: ID of the course to transfer

params.name: new_instructor_id
params.description: ID of the instructor who will own the course

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

DATABASE_PATH = "lms.db"


def transfer_course_ownership(course_id: int, new_instructor_id: int) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)) as connection:
        with connection:
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE instructor_courses SET instructor_id = ?, role = 'owner' WHERE course_id = ?",
                (new_instructor_id, course_id),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE courses SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?",
                (new_instructor_id, course_id),
            )
    return f"Course {course_id} now belongs to instructor {new_instructor_id}"
